program: on V(x) { v = x; msg = if len(x) == 0 { "Enter a name." } else if len(x) < 3 { "At least 3 characters." } else { "" }; }
view { Column { TextField { label: "Name" value: v on: V error: msg } } }

steps.why: three characters are enough: the field is valid and the message is empty
emptying the field brings the first message back
one space is a message-worthy value (too short), not a valid one
three spaces pass the length rule
